title: AdGazer: Improving Contextual Advertising with Theory-Informed Machine Learning
authors: Jianping Ye, Michel Wedel, Rik Pieters

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: AdGazer: Improving Contextual Advertising with Theory-Informed Machine Learning

eligible_reason: Machine-learning prediction of ad and brand gaze (XGBoost, CNN, multimodal LLM features) plus a randomized ad-placement experiment (BANOVA) and in-silico placement optimization. No DiD.
design_notes: README.md and zip (extracted): src/ (XGBoost, CNN, SIFT, EAST, sentence-transformer parameters), Out-of-Distribution_Samples, Shapley_and_ALE_Values, Controlled_Experiment_on_Ad_Placement (R BANOVA script, data_exp.csv), In-Silico_Experiments_random (50 sample ads). The main ad-context dataset is withheld under an Alternative Disclosure Plan (delayed release); preprocessed features are shipped.
data_access: partial (main dataset delayed under Alternative Disclosure Plan; features and experiment data public)
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract and README. Model parameter files (.pt) were extracted but not opened.
main_text_note: No DiD, fixed-effects or quasi-experiment terms in the article; ML prediction plus a randomized placement experiment.
